settings.title: Settings
settings.intro: Connect your knowledge library and choose a study rhythm that works for you.
settings.languageHint: The language changes immediately. Your cards, notes and saved study data stay unchanged.
settings.languageUnsaved: Your language preference could not be saved locally. It applies to this session; the previous language will be used next time you open the app.
settings.desktopRequired: Vault selection is available in the Tauri desktop app. For security reasons, the browser preview cannot read local folders.
settings.connectHint: FokusDeck only reads marked Markdown files. Existing vault files are not modified.
settings.timerLocked: Reset the current phase to change the timer defaults.
settings.timerSaved: Changes are saved locally and used the next time you open the app.
settings.formatAfter: at the beginning of a note. The first heading becomes the question and the remaining text becomes the answer.
settings.formatExample:
---
fokusdeck: true
deck: Biology
---
# What is photosynthesis?

Plants convert light energy
into chemical energy.
